qualification_design.mock_case: One explicitly labelled SavedWireBackend control scenario uses the public normal cancellation boundary, not a direct private _cancel call, to create a successful ACK. Verify normal duplicate receipt and binding negative controls with no additional model work. qualification_design.real_case: One real serving result, two acknowledged fragments, then actual control-channel EOF. On that same live adapter and original attempt, a valid-command replay must refuse. Preserve full namespace inventory hashes, fixed-time attempt snapshots, receipt/command state and work counters before/after; retain the original fault bytes, generated phase, two charged tickets and known prefix. No cancel-intent, cancelled, control-ack or next-piece effect may be added.

required_design.requirement: Public replay_control is a receipt lookup only. Preserve readonly-view refusal and existing clock.validate behavior; require both command_seen and a successfully saved control_ack. Match the command exactly. Never call _cancel, _save, _put_control, a.cancel, backend work, or any transition/write path from replay. First cancellation remains through the existing guarded _boundary path.

Validate all four fixed receipt references in the current namespace: control-observed.json, cancel-intent.json, cancelled.json and control-ack.json. Verify bounded reference schemas, exact slot names, bytes and SHA-256; strictly parse contents and validate journal envelope checksums. Bind observed command, identity, clock manifest pin and ACK command hash. Bind intent/final identities and their complete state relationship, not only phases or prefix lengths.

The persisted control-ack must match the in-memory ACK, and its final_record must equal the packet final_record and caller record. Verify the current a identity and complete snapshot against the persisted cancelled final payload at its saved observed_ns, including session/spec/charges/prefixes/cancel flag, wire, route, cursor, reservation and pending chunk. Comparing record to mutable in-memory final references alone is insufficient: predecessor _cancel returns the same final dict embedded in the ACK. No mutated alias may retarget a successful receipt.

Retain the existing successful same-live user_cancel duplicate call (a, final, clock.command()) with the same receipt content and no persisted or attempt-state mutation. Do not prepend the ordinary terminal guard, which deliberately refuses normal cancelled markers. Existing clock observation may advance; no new deadline-replay support is claimed because clock.validate currently accepts the user_cancel command only.

No-ACK replay, post-EOF replay, incomplete ACK disposition, readonly restored view, conflicting command, stale or mismatched record, and mismatched current attempt must refuse without writes, new output or generator work. A control fault remains unknown and is not cleared, adopted, converted to confirmed cancellation or given an ACK by replay.
